args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production after its deploy. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release verified healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified (status: rolled_out).
args.title: checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 due to failing health checks

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Reviewed deployment history**: v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollout completed and verified.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** INC-0001 documenting the failing deploy and the rollback; on-call engineer was paged.
4. **Confirmed recovery**: checkout-api is now running v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy with a 0.2% error rate.
